home.tagline: Nduzi nwere ọmịiko maka afọ ime, mgbake mgbe ọmụmụ nwa na ihe ndị ọzọ.
home.prototype: NLEBA ANYA NYOCHA NA MMEMME ỌHỤRỤ · ABUJA, NAỊJIRỊA
language.help: Họrọ asụsụ ị chọrọ. A ka na-enyocha ntụgharị ụfọdụ ozi gbasara ahụike nne.
language.notice: A ka na-atụgharị asụsụ: ụfọdụ nduzi gbasara ahụike nne ka dị n'asụsụ Bekee ruo mgbe a nyochara ntụgharị ha. Ejila ntụgharị a na-enyochabeghị eme mkpebi ahụike.
home.lead: Nkwado site n'afọ ime ruo mgbe ọmụmụ nwa na nlekọta nwa.
home.about_body: HerMamaAI na-egosi mmụta gbasara afọ ime, ahụike mgbe ọmụmụ nwa, ahụike uche, ịchọta nlekọta na ịhazi ọgwụ mgbochi ụmụaka. A ka na-anwale ya; a kwadobeghị ya site na nnwale ụlọ ọgwụ.
home.continues: Nlekọta na-aga n'ihu mgbe ọmụmụ nwa gasịrị.
home.calm: 🌼 Gaa ebe izu ike ndị nne →
safety.heading: Ozi nchekwa dị mkpa
safety.caption: Maka mmụta naanị · Ọ bụghị nnọchi nlekọta ndị ọkachamara ahụike.
ac.energy: Ike ole ka ị nwere maka obere nzọụkwụ taa?
ac.restart: Emezughị m ebumnuche gara aga ma achọrọ m ịmalite ọzọ nwayọọ
ac.steps: Obere nzọụkwụ ị nwere ike ime
ac.why: Gịnị mere e ji gosi aro ndị a?
ac.completed: Emechara m opekata mpe otu nzọụkwụ taa
